title: SeeGULL: A Stereotype Benchmark with Broad Geo-Cultural Coverage Leveraging Generative Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper's benchmark, SeeGULL, measures stereotypes about geo-cultural and national identities. It does not measure aspects of religion, but it mentions that other benchmarks like StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs do cover religion as a dimension.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as its focus is on geo-cultural stereotypes. Religion is mentioned only as a dimension covered by prior work and as a potential area for future extension.
